notes.title: New Free Mini-Game, Grendel 2048+ Added to Grendel's Cave
notes.content: [p]Grendel's Cave now includes a new mini-game; Grendel 2048+. This is a plus version of the popular tile merging game 2048, with Grendel's Cave themed tile images and NPC. The plus version includes enhanced play elements given for merging three in a row and four in a row tiles, completing levels and adding points. The enhancing play elements allow you to use a sword to remove a tile, use Mjolnir to remove all tiles of a given type, use an hourglass to switch the position of two tiles on the game board. The great thing about this game is you can earn Steam lives by completing levels or winning the game for use in the main Grendel's Cave adventure game. Alternately, if you have an online Grendel's Cave account and play the online game, you can earn Loot Box Codes for the online game in the new mini-game, if you choose from mini-game's setup. [/p][p]I hope you all enjoy this new bonus mini-game. To play, open the main game from Steam and at the bottom of the main game's home page Setting and Thane tabs is a button labeled 2048. Click that button and you go to the Grendel 2048+ game board and can play it there. Click on the Quit button to go back to the main Grendel's Cave game page.[/p][p]Try Grendel 2048+, earn lives or Loot Box Codes, climb to the top of the 2048 Leaderboard, and earn the two 2048+ Achievements. One for completing the Grendel level of the game and the second for completing all levels and winning the game.[/p][p]-- Beowulf[/p]

notes.title: Grendel and Mother End Game Boss Fights Quicker
notes.content:
Friends of GC,

This version v1.0.4.2 makes Grendel much more accessible to fight once you put on a completed amulet. Mother is also quicker to show once Grendel has been killed. I made these changes to speed up the end game boss fights, so you don't end up standing around waiting for G and mom to show themselves to fight.

Thanks all for purchasing and player GC2D,

Beowulf

notes.title: Steam Lives and Premiums
notes.content:
Friends of GC,

This new version, v1.0.3.0, adds Steam Lives and in-game Protection from Death Premiums; no online account required

You can now earn Lives native to Steam without any need for an external online account. You earn these Lives by killing Grendel, Mother and the Dragon in the various kingdom types. In an Intermediate Kingdom you earn one Life each for killing Grendel, Mother and the Dragon. In an Advanced Kingdom you earn three lives for killing Grendel and one life each for Mother and the Dragon. In a Tournament Kingdom you earn 20 lives for killing Grendel and five lives each for Mother and the Dragon.

You can use these Lives for payments for additional abilities on your thanes, or to play in Tournament Kingdom type kingdoms. You can also use lives to purchase in-game Protection from Death Premiums, either 1-day, 1-week or 1-month Protection from Death. No online account is required for these new in-game premiums. 

If you have Lives, either Steam or online, then you will see a Premium button on the Settings tab of the game. Click on this button to trade lives for your choice of the in-game Protection from Death Premiums.

I hope you enjoy the new Steam Lives and in-game premiums, so you can enjoy more Grendel's Cave content without an online account. In the near future I am adding more exciting ways to earn lives with additional expanded game content. That is coming next, hopefully in the June release.

Have fun, and please, kill more monsters,

Beowulf

notes.title: Grendel's Cave Steam Integration
notes.content:
Dear friends of GC,

This new version of Grendel's Cave adds Steam Achievements and Leaderboards! You can earn achievements for killing Grendel, Mother and the Dragon in Intermediate, Advanced and Tournament type kingdoms, for a total of nine different achievements. I added a points leaderboard for points earned by slaying Grendel, Mother and the Dragon, 1 point for each in an Intermediate kingdom, 2 points each for an Advanced kingdom and 3 points each for a Tournament kingdom. The more you slay, the more points your earn and the higher your place on this leaderboard. I also added a total thane's values leaderboard. Your place on this board is based on the total value of your up to six active thanes.

I added a tenth achievement for King of Grendel's Cave. If you have the most points and then the highest thane's value total then you are given the King of GC achievement, which you get to keep as long as you are the King. If another player becomes King then you may lose your achievement. I added a third leaderboard for King of GC, which keeps track of the current King of GC as the top player on this leaderboard.

Enjoy these new achievements and leaderboards, and as always, please kill more monsters and slay more Grendels.

-- Beowulf
